lessons: First review since publication (2026-06-02). The evidence gate had never been run with --check-sources: 5 of 21 snippets failed, including one (haredi-age) that was a splice of two separate sentences joined by an authored connective, and two Consumer Protection Law snippets that were paraphrases rather than statute text. Re-run --check-sources every cycle, not just the default self-consistency pass.

evidence.json was on the legacy key schema (id / source_fetched_at / confidence). It still had source_url and raw_snippet so the gate was not fully inert, but it was normalized to canonical keys this cycle.

A percent-encoded Hebrew URL in the body injected phantom 20% and 95% claims into the extractor, and the literal form contains a space so the extractor truncates it. Neither form works in the body: keep such URLs in evidence.json only. The BTL average-wage link was dropped from Reference Links for this reason.

The legal gate moved this skill to Tier B (NOTICE_REQUIRED) once the body started stating operative Consumer Protection Law rules and instructing the agent to name which gates apply to the user's own product. A '## Legal notice' section and an 'אינו ייעוץ משפטי. / Not legal advice. ' description prefix were added. Never let optimize-descriptions strip that prefix.

Expert MAJOR deferred, B2B lens (M1-M6): Step 2b routes B2B users through Step 5's Hebrew-first mandate, which is wrong for Israeli B2B SaaS where English is the working language; and it names no registry for counting accounts (CBS Business Register, IVC-Online, Start-Up Nation Finder, Dun's 100), omits Israel Invoice allocation numbers, export-of-services zero-rating under VAT Law s.30(a)(5)/(7), חוק מוסר תשלומים לספקים, SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / BoI Directive 361 security gates, and the חוק חובת המכרזים / מכרז זוטא / Accountant General supplier-registration mechanics. Fix the Hebrew-first inversion FIRST next cycle: it is a wrong instruction, not merely an omission.

Expert MAJOR deferred, missing segments (M7-M9): Negev Bedouin (unrecognized villages have no street addresses, which makes courier delivery structurally unserviceable rather than merely expensive), Ethiopian-Israeli, Druze, migrant workers and asylum seekers, and the Litvish / Hasidic / Sephardi split inside the Haredi row, plus the kosher-phone whitelist meaning a device may be unable to load the product at all.

Expert MAJOR deferred (M10-M11): out-of-scope rows 2 and 3 leave Step 3's 'defensible adoption fraction' with no method of defence (Hebrew search-demand validation) and Step 7's 'cost floor' undefined (in consumer markets that floor is CAC, and no Israeli CPM/CPC or LTV:CAC check exists anywhere in the skill). Re-litigate both rows next cycle.

Expert MINOR deferred (M12 and Hebrew polish): פסיקה is judicial-case-law register and is the wrong word for the deliverable, used about eight times including the שלב 7 heading; should be הכרעה or המלצה. Also three calques and Latin-leading RTL lines at the go / pivot / no-go list, which violates the Hebrew line-start rule.
metadata.json carries 7 tags per locale while release.yml expects at most 3, so a tag push may not cut a signed release. Verify signed_release after this cycle's tag and trim tags if it stays false.

Deferred over the Phase 4.1 discretionary cap: add gemini-spark, grok and grok-build to supported_agents. The skill is a pure reasoning workflow and the bundled script makes no network calls, so it should run on Spark; check the description length against DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH first, now that the legal prefix has been added.

Deferred: Yad2's ownership changed (KKR sole owner Mar 2025, then Apax agreed to buy it for about 950M USD). Its role as the dominant classifieds channel is unchanged, so the claim still holds, but the source is a Wikipedia description and should be upgraded.

Deferred: paybox's 1.4 million customers figure is understated (roughly 1.5M monthly active, about 2.5M registered) and Bit-to-paybox interoperability was expected by end-2026. No body claim depends on either number.

Deferred: the CBS economy-wide average wage (about 15,223 NIS per employee post, June 2026) runs roughly 12 percent above the s.1 statutory figure the skill cites. This cycle relabeled 13,566 as the statutory measure rather than substituting a news-sourced CBS figure. Next cycle, source the CBS series directly (or via the israeli-cbs MCP) and give consumer pricing its own benchmark number.

Deferred: Meta's reported January 2026 WhatsApp Business API changes (mandatory Business Verification plus a privacy-policy URL before template messages, and a bar on general-purpose assistant bots) were not verified against a Meta-owned policy page, so nothing was encoded.

Platform ad-policy drift for Meta, Google, LinkedIn and X since June 2026 was UNVERIFIABLE against platform-owned sources; only aggregator blogs surfaced. Nothing was encoded. The two verified platform and election findings were TikTok's Israeli election ruleset and the 26.7.2026 deep-fake disclosure rules.
The personal-import VAT exemption moved three times in six months (75 to 150 to 130 to 75). Treat it as a per-cycle re-check item, not a constant.

kolzchut.org.il and gov.il are Cloudflare-blocked to curl and WebFetch. Kol Zchut and gov.il both render in the Playwright browser; assert location.href before reading, since a shared browser returned an unrelated page under the requested URL twice this cycle. The Kol Zchut wage citation was swapped to the BTL primary table, which is reachable by plain fetch.
